details:
- Upgrade to tzdata-2026e
  - Manitoba moves to permanent -05 on 2026-10-31.
  - Canada’s Northwest Territories moved to permanent -06 on 2026-08-21.
  - Obsolescent settings like TZ="EST5EDT" now conform better to POSIX.
  - Fix security, performance and porting bugs in zic and localtime.
  - Alberta moved to permanent -06 on 2026-06-18.
  - Morocco moves to permanent +00 on 2026-09-20.
  - More integer overflow bugs have been fixed in zic.
  - British Columbia moved to permanent -07 on 2026-03-09.
  - zic no longer mishandles a last transition to a new time type.
  - Some more overflow bugs have been fixed in zic.
  - Moldova has used EU transition times since 2022.
  - The “right” TZif files are no longer installed by default.
  - -DTZ_RUNTIME_LEAPS=0 disables runtime support for leap seconds.
  - TZif files are no longer limited to 50 bytes of abbreviations.
  - zic is no longer limited to 50 leap seconds.
  - Several integer overflow bugs have been fixed.
  - Several code changes for compatibility with FreeBSD.
- Drop 0003-continue-to-ship-posixrules.patch: POSIXRULES is obsolete
  since tzcode 2026a; posixrules is still produced by zic -p
- Use the tzdata<ver>-rearguard.tar.gz.t make target renamed in tzcode 2026
